_notes: Script and register: the bundle is Serbian Cyrillic, so every patch is Cyrillic. Student-facing copy uses the polite 'ви' form (lowercase, as Serbian orthography prescribes) in full sentences; short button/tab labels use the conventional Serbian UI imperative singular (Пошаљи, Отпреми, Изабери) that the bundle already uses. Two 'ти'-register strings (mobile:v3.home.noCounselor, mobile:v3.quick.createAccount) were moved to 'ви'. Staff-facing mobile:agency.*, mobile:university.*, mobile:v3.agency.*, mobile:v3.uni.*, mobile:v3.reviews.* are concise and formal.

'matches' (the algorithmic fit shown in the Student app) was 'подударања', which reads as a literal calque in Serbian; unified to 'одговарајући програми' / 'програми који вам одговарају' / 'универзитети који вам одговарају'. 'University recommendation' (the team's proposals) stays a separate term: 'препоруке универзитета'.

plan = план everywhere (пакет dropped in v15/v16/v26/settings); additional service = додатна услуга; service period = период услуге; consultation = консултација; mock interview = пробни интервју (пробни разговор dropped), interview = интервју; managed application = пријаве које водимо са вама; document review = провера докумената ('прегледи' dropped for documents; 'прегледа' kept only for essays/profiles, a different act); the agency 'verify' action that sets the verified state = потврди / потврђено, distinct from contact 'verify' = провери / проверено in sign-up; visa document preparation = припрема докумената за визу (never 'припрема визе' alone, so no visa is implied); arrival/settling-in = помоћ при доласку и сналажењу, 'Help after you arrive' = помоћ након доласка.

Official names: standard admission letter = стандардно писмо о пријему (written in full wherever the English says 'standard'); admission letter alone = писмо о пријему; apostille = апостил; consular legalization = конзуларна легализација; notarization = овера код јавног бележника; D-2 / D-4 / C-3 / E-7 / F codes kept; TOPIK/IELTS/TOEFL iBT kept; GKS not present in this job.

personal statement = мотивационо писмо (the term Serbian applicants use for 자기소개서; 'лична изјава' is not idiomatic); study plan = план студија (план студирања dropped). 'editing' of essays = исправке.

offer = понуда за упис; 'Admitted' = Примљени сте; enrollment = упис; intake = уписни рок; applicant (university console) = кандидат; dormitory = студентски дом; housing (topic) = смештај; transcript = препис оцена; checklist = листа задатака (or листа in tight labels); vault = 'на једном сигурном месту' / 'документа' (no literal 'трезор').

Counselor: student-facing strings that said 'ваш саветник' (mobile:v3.home.nextBody.ESSAY_WRITE, mobile:v4.application.reviewLate, mobile:v4.application.writeOnWeb, mobile:v4.home.item.WRITE_ESSAY.text) now follow the English and say тим Hangyul; staff-facing strings keep саветник. 'Hangyul team' = тим Hangyul, 'Hangyul Univ team' = тим Hangyul Univ, following the English per key.

Serbian needs three plural forms. Every count-bearing _one/_other pair whose noun inflects got a _few form (2–4, 22–24 …): e.g. 1 непрочитана порука / 2 непрочитане поруке / 5 непрочитаних порука. Keys whose number is detached from the noun (Рок данас · {{count}}, Провере, чека: {{count}}) were kept without _few. Keys that have only _one/_other and carry a count next to a noun with no plural variant available (mobile:student.nextAction.PROFILE_UNLOCK.*) were rephrased so the number sits in brackets after the noun ('програме ({{count}})') and reads correctly for any number.
Email/SMS: имејл and СМС (Cyrillic) are used everywhere; the few 'е-порука' / Latin 'SMS' strings in student:register.verify.delivery.* were aligned.

Legal consent summaries (CROSS_BORDER_VERIFICATION, PRIVACY) were aligned to the reviewed English in both student:register and mobile:signup, and the two apps now use identical consent wording; the earlier Serbian carried extra detail (retention period, 'хеш лозинке') not in the English.
Localized examples: 'e.g. Hanoi National University' → 'нпр. Универзитет у Београду'; the career example mentions корејских и српских компанија. Owner may prefer the English examples kept literally.

Product names mobile:app.agency / mobile:app.student / mobile:app.university ('Hangyul Agency', 'Hangyul Univ', 'Hangyul University') are kept in Latin as brand names; mobile:v29.plan.arrivalWindow is a pure placeholder string and was left as is.
